Would you like to play a key part in Toca Boca’s Data & Research engine? With over 60 million monthly active users and terabytes of daily data, as a Senior Data Scientist, you will play an integral role in understanding how kids and families engage with our play ecosystem, directly shaping fantastic, safe, and imaginative play experiences.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into narrow corporate silos or endless maintenance tasks. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will enjoy broad end-to-end ownership across the entire product lifecycle—from exploratory data science, advanced modeling, and experimentation to product strategy and monetization dynamics.

You’ll join our Data & Analytics team while partnering seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner. Together, we blend big data behavioral telemetry with qualitative player research, working closely with cross-functional game teams to unlock the full value of our play ecosystem.

What you’ll be doing

Uncover Deep Player Insights: Analyze complex player datasets to understand behavioral patterns, feature engagement, and retention drivers across our games, informing overall product and commerce strategy.
Apply Advanced Statistical Methods: Apply statistical models, regression analysis, predictive segmentation, and experimental methods (A/B testing) to optimize product performance at scale.
Bridge Quantitative & Qualitative Insights: Partner seamlessly with our User Research team under a unified Insights banner, connecting the "what" (big data trends) with the "why" (qualitative research) to deliver a 360-degree understanding of our players.
End-to-End Ownership & Influence: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous game product questions. Partner directly with PMs, Designers, and Engineers to translate complex datasets into clear, data-backed recommendations.
Innovate & Evolve Workflows: Continuously refine our analytics capabilities by leveraging modern data science workflows, predictive modeling, and AI tools to accelerate discovery and analysis.

What Success Looks Like

Trusted Co-pilot: You become a trusted analytical partner to game teams, shaping product decisions through rigorous data science, experimentation, and player empathy.
Broad Impact: You thrive with the freedom to influence multiple product areas—from core play loops and feature design to commerce and top-of-funnel engagement—without being pigeonholed.
Holistic Insights: You successfully bridge quantitative behavioral data with qualitative user research to create unified narratives that inspire game design.
Autonomy & Momentum: You help teams move quickly by surfacing key facts, reducing ambiguity, and solving open-ended problems that don't have predefined playbooks.

Is This You?

3+ years of experience (or equivalent senior-level impact) in user-focused Data Science or Advanced Product Analytics within Gaming, Mobile Apps, or Interactive Digital Products.
Empathy & Product Sense: Deep curiosity and intuition for player experience, engagement, and kids' digital environments.
SQL Mastery & Data Exploration: Outstanding SQL skills querying cloud data warehouses (experience with Google BigQuery and DBT is a huge plus).
Advanced DS Toolkit: Proficiency in Python (or R) for statistical modeling, machine learning, segmentation, and exploratory deep dives. Experience with BI tools like Tableau or Looker is a great plus!
Rigorous Statistical Foundation: Strong track record in experimentation lifecycle design, A/B test analysis, and hypothesis testing.
AI & Modern Workflows (Nice to have): Curiosity or Hands-on experience building, integrating, or utilizing AI/LLM tools within your data workflows or analytics stack.
Clear Storytelling & Autonomy: Skilled at translating complex quantitative and qualitative data into simple, compelling recommendations for non-technical partners. Thrives with high autonomy in fast-paced environments.

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Lylli and Originator, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

Are you a highly capable finance professional who wants to build and manage the financial backbone of a rapidly growing deep-tech and medical technology company?
Ascilion is now recruiting a Financial Controller to the company. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Kista.
At Ascilion we are singularly focused on solving one of medicine’s big challenges: providing real-time access to molecular biomarkers. Ascilion’s proprietary, industry-leading microneedle technology enables quick, reliable, and painless access to molecular biomarkers.
Ascilion is entering a phase of significant international growth with substantial investor involvement, increasing reporting requirements, expanding operations, and likely future subsidiaries and / or international sales entities. We already work with strong external partners in bookkeeping and audits, but we now need an internal financial leader who owns the full picture and ensures the company operates at a world-class level financially and operationally.
The Financial Controller is a key leadership position responsible for the overall financial management of the company, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of our financial reporting. Depending on profile and experience, the role may develop into a CFO position and become part of the senior management team with responsibility for strategic financial planning and board-level reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for you to join a dedicated and highly competent team and a growing company with an exciting journey ahead. If this sounds interesting to you, please contact us using the details below!
We will interview candidates continuously for the position and welcome your application today.
Responsibilities
As our Financial Controller, you will drive the company’s financial success by ensuring reporting accuracy, robust compliance, and strategic control over day-to-day financial operations. You will report directly to the CEO.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and manage the company’s financial operations and reporting structure

Ensure high-quality financial reporting towards investors, board, auditors, and authorities

Prepare board material, financial presentations, forecasts, and KPI reporting

Coordinate and manage relationships with bookkeeping firms, auditors, banks, investors, and external financial partners

Develop and improve internal financial processes, controls, and reporting systems

Support international expansion including subsidiaries, sales offices, and cross-border financial structures

Drive budgeting, liquidity planning, cash flow management, and long-term financial planning

Ensure audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and professional financial governance

Support operational scaling of the company together with management and technical leadership

Potentially take responsibility for HR administration, contracts, insurance, and internal operational processes depending on profile and interest

Your Profile
Key qualifications for the position include:

Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Economics.

Several years of experience in accounting, with a strong focus on financial reporting, accounting, controlling, and compliance

Experience working with investors, boards, auditors, and external financial stakeholders

Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and corporate governance

A deep understanding of Swedish GAAP. Direct experience with US GAAP or IFRS is a competitive advantage

Experience from scaling companies, international operations, startups, medtech, deep-tech, or manufacturing environments is highly valuable

Experience with subsidiaries, international reporting structures, or US operations is a strong plus

Fluency in Swedish and English

We are looking for a structured, reliable, and highly detailed-oriented professional who enjoys taking ownership and creating order and clarity in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. As a person, you are analytical, strategic, pragmatic and execution-focused, with a strong ability to work with both details and the bigger picture. You have strong communication and collaboration skills, and you are comfortable operating close to both management and technical teams and presenting financial information clearly to both investors and engineers. Importantly, you thrive in an ambitious, high-performance environment and want to help build a globally significant company, not just manage spreadsheets
At Ascilion, you will have the opportunity to make an impact not only in your own area of responsibility, but also on the development of the company as a whole.
About Ascilion
Ascilion was founded in 2012 with a mission to solve the problem of sampling dermal interstitial fluid in an efficient and pain-free way. A team of engineers with deep experience in MEMS technology and microfluidics took on the challenge of solving what turned out to be a very complex problem.
We exist to bridge the worlds of precision engineering and biomarker science, creating innovative microneedle technologies that make dISF accessible, reliable, and painless; empowering researchers, clinicians, and companies to unlock the full potential of health monitoring and diagnostics.
We are currently in a very exciting expansion phase where we grow all aspects of the organization from R&D to sales. Our customer base is increasing with numerous close collaborations in Europe, the US, and Asia. Come, join our journey!
To learn more about us please visit www.ascilion.com

Job Description
As Unit Manager for Identity & Access Management (IAM), you will lead one of H&M Group’s most critical cyber security capabilities and play a key role in strengthening the organisation’s security, resilience and ability to deliver on its strategic ambitions. 
As a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team reporting to the CISO, you will share accountability for the overall cyber security strategy, priorities and long-term development of the Cyber Security function. Working closely with leaders across business, technology and cyber security, you will help shape outcomes that balance business objectives, security needs and risk management across H&M Group. 
You will provide strategic leadership for H&M Group’s global IAM capability through an established leadership team spanning the end-to-end identity lifecycle. Through your leadership, you will drive the continued evolution of IAM, ensuring the capability remains effective, scalable and aligned with the future needs of the business. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the strategic direction, maturity and long-term development of H&M Group’s Identity & Access Management capability, defining and evolving the IAM strategy, roadmap and operating model in alignment with business, technology and cyber security objectives. 
Contribute as a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team to the overall cyber security strategy, priorities, operating model and long-term capability development. 
Build strong partnerships with business, technology and cyber security stakeholders to drive alignment, influence decisions and enable strategic outcomes. 
Drive organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, capability development and succession planning within the IAM function. 
Ensure effective management of IAM-related risks, controls, regulatory obligations and strategic initiatives. 
Lead budgeting, resource and investment planning, vendor strategy and prioritisation to support delivery of IAM and cyber security objectives. 
Foster a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation and business value. 

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with:
8+ years of people management experience in cyber security, IAM or a closely related field. 
Proven experience leading an enterprise-scale IAM capability end to end in a global organisation, spanning governance, risk and compliance, architecture, engineering, delivery and operations. 
Proven experience leading through managers and developing high-performing leadership teams, with full ownership of a multidisciplinary organisation and its outcomes. 
Experience as a member of a senior cyber security, technology or enterprise leadership team, contributing to shared strategy, priorities, investment decisions and organisational outcomes beyond the individual’s own area of responsibility. 
Experience defining and executing enterprise IAM strategies, roadmaps, operating models and large-scale transformation, including organisational change across functional and organisational boundaries. 
Strong knowledge of IAM capabilities and technologies, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorisation and privileged access management, as well as enterprise IGA platforms such as Saviynt, SailPoint or similar. 
Strong knowledge of IAM-related risks, controls, policies, regulatory requirements and audit expectations. 
Experience managing significant budgets, investments, resources, sourcing arrangements and external partners, including leading negotiations with strategic vendors. 
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with proven experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders, clearly communicating strategic direction and translating complex IAM, cyber security and risk topics into business implications, priorities and decisions. 
Sound judgement and decision-making capability in complex, uncertain and risk-sensitive situations. 
Relevant certifications in IAM, cyber security or risk management are considered beneficial. 

Additional Information
This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.
Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation 
At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age. 
Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. 
Our Offer 
At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.

At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs, today and in the future.
 
We are looking for a Junior Technology Engineer who is eager to develop within process technology, problem-solving, and manufacturing development for our growing Kromasil business. You are curious, analytical, and enjoy tackling complex challenges together with experienced specialists. Does that sound like you?
 
About the job 
Kromasil is a strategic growth area within Nouryon, with several ongoing expansion projects both in Sweden and globally. Kromasil is Nouryon's leading chromatography media used in the separation and purification of pharmaceuticals, including life-saving medicines. As demand continues to grow globally, Kromasil is a strategic growth area for Nouryon with several ongoing expansion and development projects.
 
You will join an experienced technology team where you will learn the process in depth and develop into a subject matter expert over time.
 
In your future role as technology engineer you will
· Contribute to investment projects (CAPEX) as a process engineer or technical specialist.
· Drive and support continuous improvement initiatives related to production, quality, and process efficiency.
· Troubleshoot and resolve complex production challenges together with manufacturing teams and senior engineers.
· Perform data analysis, process simulations, and modelling to optimize production processes and equipment.
· Participate in root cause investigations related to quality, safety, and reliability.
· Support new product introductions, technology transfers, and scale-up activities.
 
We believe you bring
· B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
· Some industrial experience, or you are a recent graduate with a strong interest in manufacturing technology and process improvement.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
· Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
· A structured approach to work and a willingness to learn and grow over the long term.
 
Great if you have
· Experience from the chemical, pharmaceutical, or process industry.
· Experience with AspenTech or similar process simulation tools.
· Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, data analysis, AI-enabled engineering tools, or DCS systems such as DeltaV.
· Proficiency in Swedish, both written and spoken.
 
We believe you are
A positive and curious person who sees opportunities rather than obstacles. You learn quickly, are not afraid to get hands-on in the plant environment, and enjoy collaborating with others. You are structured, communicative, and able to explain technical concepts in a clear and constructive way. Most importantly, we value attitude, potential, and a genuine interest in developing both yourself and our business.
 
We offer you
You will become part of a small and highly experienced technology team with deep expertise in the Kromasil process. The role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with senior experts while contributing to production support, process development, and major investment projects.
 
The position is based in Gothenburg, with close collaboration with the Bohus production site and opportunities to contribute to international projects as the business continues to grow and the position will therefore include travels globally.
 
At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. Our collective agreement is with IKEM. We also offer benefits such as bonus, reduced working hours, wellness allowance, lunch allowance, and more.
 
Have we got your interest? 
This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, and starts with a six-month probationary period
reporting to Roy Hammer-Olsen and Global Technology Manager and based in Gothenburg, Gamlestaden.
 
Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/
 
As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process.

As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff.
 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
About Nouryon 
Explore careers and life at Nouryon
 
If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.
Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.
 
Contact 
For additional information about the vacancy please contact hiring manager Roy Hammer-Olsen, Global Technology Manager, roy.hammer-olsen@nouryon.com.

#WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs

At SSC Space, you are part of something bigger.  
Every day, our people contribute to missions that expand knowledge, support critical services, and help society benefit from space. We believe the best results come from passionate experts who collaborate, take ownership, and turn ambitious ideas into reality.   
As our Market Analyst, you will join a team where trust, responsibility, and continuous learning are a natural part of everyday work. You'll work closely with knowledgeable colleagues from around the world while helping shape the future of SSC Space.   
Our work is guided by Customer Passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity and Courage. We look for colleagues who bring these values to life in how they collaborate, make decisions and take on challenges.   
Working within our Commercial function, you will be close to both strategic and commercial decision-making. Your insights will support areas such as business strategy, commercial planning, business development and product management. 
This is a role for someone who enjoys combining analytical depth with a broader business perspective. You will not only analyze existing information, but also help develop how we collect, structure and use market intelligence across the organization.  

JOB REQUIREMENTS
We believe you will thrive in this role if you have a strong analytical mindset combined with curiosity about markets, industries and business. 
We are looking for someone with: 
A university degree in a relevant field, such as business, finance, economics, data analytics or another quantitative discipline. 
Experience working with market analysis, business analysis, competitive intelligence, strategy, customer insights, commercial analytics or a similar area. 
Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex datasets and turn them into clear conclusions and recommendations. 
Experience with market sizing, forecasting, business modelling or similar analytical methods. 
Advanced Excel skills, including complex models, calculations, forecasting and scenario analysis, together with proficiency in relevant analytical software and AI tools. 
The ability to critically assess different data sources, methodologies and assumptions rather than simply reporting the numbers. 
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex analysis in a clear and useful way to different stakeholders. 
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.  

We are particularly interested in your analytical ability, business understanding and curiosity, as well as your motivation to develop how market intelligence can support better decisions. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
In this role, you will: 
Analyze market trends, developments, market size and future growth opportunities. 
Monitor competitors, including their activities, investments, partnerships and new offerings, and assess what these developments could mean for our business. 
Provide quantitative analysis and market insights to support commercial and strategic decisions. 
Develop and maintain analytical models, forecasting tools, dashboards, databases and business scenarios. 
Drive competitive intelligence and market share analysis, helping us build a stronger understanding of our position in the market. 
Bring market intelligence together in a more structured and accessible way, including developing a central market intelligence database. 
Explore opportunities to use automation, AI and analytical tools to strengthen competitor and industry monitoring, analysis and reporting. 
Work with external data providers and evaluate different sources to ensure that the information we use is relevant and reliable. 
Maintain high standards for data quality, methodologies, assumptions and calculations. 
Provide market data and insights for the Annual Report and, when required, reporting to the Executive Committee and Board. 
Collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Strategy, Customer Intelligence, Sales Analytics, Commercial Excellence and CRM to connect different sources of data and turn them into meaningful insights. 

JOB BENEFITS
We offer you   
Meaningful work connected to science, society and the future of space.  
The opportunity to collaborate with talented and passionate colleagues across disciplines, countries, and missions.  
Real responsibility, trust, and the freedom to influence both your work and your development.  
A unique chance to contribute directly to projects where you can see the impact of your ideas and efforts.   

Additional benefits  
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.   
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.  
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.   
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.  
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.  
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  

LOCATION
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.  

NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  
We would like to inform you that as the application period runs close to the Christmas holidays, our feedback and next steps may take a little longer than usual. We appreciate your patience during this period. 
As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.    

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE
SSC Space is a trusted end-to-end mission partner and employer of choice, recognized for reliability, expertise and enabling mission success. From satellite communications and spacecraft operations to launch services, engineering, and consultancy, we help customers around the world achieve their space ambitions.   
Limitless Together.

About LAYERED
Founded in 2015, LAYERED is a Swedish interior brand specialising in handcrafted rugs. With the floor as its starting point, LAYERED creates distinctive foundations that anchor a room and bring its elements together – true centrepieces.
Working predominantly with flatweave and tufted rugs, the collections place a strong emphasis on artistry, craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Alongside its own collections, LAYERED collaborates with internationally recognised designers and artists, including Tom Morris, Collina Strada and Massproductions, exploring new perspectives on the role of rugs within contemporary interiors.
With an established presence in Sweden and a growing international business, LAYERED is now focused on accelerating its commercial development, strengthening its position in key markets and building a scalable, profitable business across its sales channels.
About the role
This is a one-year fixed-term position starting in March 2027.
LAYERED is looking for a hands-on and commercially minded E-commerce Specialist to join the team. You will take an active role in the daily operations and continuous development of LAYERED's online business, with a focus on driving sales, improving conversion and creating a seamless digital customer experience.
In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day e-commerce activities, working across website optimization, merchandising, CRM and customer retention. You will ensure that products, content and campaigns are presented in a commercially effective way, while continuously identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey and online performance.
You will work closely with colleagues across marketing and technology, combining hands-on execution with data-driven improvements. As part of a smaller, entrepreneurial organisation, you will have the opportunity to take initiative, contribute ideas and make a direct impact on the online business.
Key responsibilities:
Manage and optimize LAYERED's day-to-day e-commerce operations, ensuring an engaging and commercially effective shopping experience.
Develop onsite merchandising, product presentation, landing pages and campaign content to improve conversion and sales.
Drive CRM activities, including newsletters, customer segmentation, automated customer journeys and retention initiatives.
Analyze e-commerce performance, customer behaviour and key KPIs to identify opportunities and implement improvements.
Coordinate and execute digital campaigns, product launches and commercial activities in collaboration with the marketing team.
Continuously improve website usability, navigation and the overall customer journey, with a focus on conversion rate optimization (CRO).
Contribute to SEO improvements and explore opportunities to optimize digital content and processes through new technologies and AI.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support the ongoing development of the e-commerce business, including operational activities related to the B2B portal.

Your background
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on E-commerce Specialist who can quickly step into the role and take ownership of the daily e-commerce operations. You have a solid background in operational e-commerce and are confident working independently across website optimization, merchandising and CRM. You understand how website performance, customer behaviour and commercial activities contribute to online sales, and you know how to turn insights into practical improvements.
You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your responsibilities and managing multiple activities simultaneously. You have a structured and analytical approach, but you are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting things done.
To succeed at LAYERED, you enjoy working in a smaller, entrepreneurial organisation where collaboration, flexibility and initiative are part of everyday work. You are solution-oriented, proactive and confident in identifying opportunities and driving improvements without extensive guidance.
We would like you to have:
Solid experience in an operational e-commerce role, with the ability to take ownership and deliver results from the start.
Hands-on experience managing and optimizing an online store, including product presentation, onsite merchandising and website content.
Practical experience in CRM and email marketing, including newsletters, customer segmentation, automated flows and performance optimization.
A strong commercial understanding of e-commerce KPIs, conversion, customer behaviour and online sales.
Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and implement improvements.
The ability to independently plan, prioritise and execute e-commerce activities.
Experience working with content and campaigns in collaboration with marketing teams.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms, an understanding of B2B e-commerce, and an interest in GEO/SEO, AI and emerging digital technologies are considered advantages.
What LAYERED Offers
LAYERED offers an opportunity to take a central commercial leadership role within a Swedish design brand with an established international presence and clear ambitions for continued growth.
You will have significant influence over the company’s commercial direction, working closely with the CEO to shape the next phase of development. With e-commerce as a key growth driver and further potential within international markets and B2B, you will have the opportunity to develop new business opportunities and strengthen the company’s commercial foundation.
You will join an entrepreneurial organisation with short decision-making processes, close collaboration and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the business.
Location & Start
The position is based in central Stockholm, with a start date in March 2027.
Contact & Application
In this recruitment, LAYERED is partnering with E-commerce Recruit. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact the responsible recruiter, Julia Salming, at at julia@ecommercerecruit.se.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application!

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
This position reports to: Head of Strategy & M&A.
Position overview:
You will be a member of the Division's strategy team and report directly to the Division Head of Strategy. Together, the team provides the Division President and the Business Line leaders with the facts and analysis behind their strategic decisions.
In a typical month you will research a market or a competitor, build the numbers behind a business case, profile a company proposed as an acquisition or partner, and prepare the material for the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives. You will help shape strategic questions, conduct valuable research, get to validated numbers, collaborate across business lines and functions, and produce high-quality first drafts.
We believe in combining careful thinking with modern tools. You should be comfortable using and building AI-enabled workflows and agents to accelerate analysis and execution, while maintaining responsibility for data security, accuracy, and ownership on the conclusions you draw.
You are expected to form your own view, think critically constructively and professionally lead defined workstreams from question to decision-ready output.
Key responsibilities
Analysis and drafting:
Researches markets, customers and competitors and analyzes internal business data to develop and evaluate growth opportunities.
Builds financial models (market size, growth, cost, profitability) and business plans, with sources and assumptions documented.
Produces high-quality first drafts of briefs, reports and presentations for Division, Business Area and corporate reviews.
Follows competitor, market and technology developments, keeps the Division's market data current and prepares regular updates for leadership.

Planning and follow-up:
Supports the annual strategic planning cycle and the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives: collects and checks input from the Business Lines, updates trackers and dashboards, and prepares the review material.

Acquisitions and partnerships:
Screens and profiles companies and technologies as acquisition or partnership candidates, including inbound proposals, and keeps the pipeline records up to date.
Supports strategy projects and the Division's part in acquisition and partnership projects run with the Business Area Automation M&A team, including analysis, coordination of Business Line input and follow-up of assigned tasks.

The strategy function:
Owns defined analytical workstreams supporting strategy workshops and leadership-team reviews, from preparation through follow-up.
Helps continuously improve the team's analytical tools, templates and AI-enabled ways of working.
Maintains the function's planning calendar, files and information base and responds to recurring information requests.

Key requirements
Relevant professional experience: 5+ years of experience in management consulting, transaction advisory, corporate strategy, business development, business controlling, or a comparable analytical role in an industrial environment.
Academic background: University degree in business, economics, engineering, the natural sciences or a related discipline.
Financial and analytical capabilities: Solid financial-modelling skills and sound understanding of P&L, cash flow, business cases, valuation fundamentals and scenario analysis. Models should be transparent, decision-oriented and structured so that assumptions and sensitivities can be readily reviewed.
Structured problem-solving: Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear hypotheses, analytical workplans and practical recommendations.

JOIN US

Automotive electronics expertise

Results-driven mindset

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on cutting-edge automotive technologies and contribute to innovative products that shape the future of mobility. At Voyado we’re growing internationally, and with growth comes new opportunities, challenges, and decisions to make. That’s where you come in!
We’re looking for an FP&A Lead who combines a sharp analytical mind with a strong commercial mindset. Someone who’s curious about the business behind the numbers, enjoys working with people, and isn’t afraid to challenge assumptions or bring new ideas to the table.
This is a role where you’ll get the best of both worlds: taking the lead in a small team while staying close to the business and getting hands-on with the numbers yourself.
Sound like your kind of challenge? Keep reading!
About the role
As our FP&A Lead, you’ll connect financial performance with what’s happening across the business.
You’ll provide day-to-day leadership for a team of business controllers, setting priorities and supporting their success without formal people-management responsibilities. Working closely with stakeholders across Voyado, you’ll turn financial insights into meaningful conversations that help drive smarter business decisions.
You’ll also help develop our FP&A processes and ways of working as we continue to scale. You’ll report directly to our CFO, Björn Källén.
Some things you'll be up to:
Partner with the business. Work closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, challenge assumptions, and bring financial and commercial perspectives to the table.
Stay hands-on. Own financial planning, forecasting, performance follow-ups, and analysis for your business areas.
Connect the dots. Analyze SaaS metrics and business performance to identify opportunities, understand what’s driving growth, and support better decisions.
Lead by example. Guide the team’s day-to-day work, support your colleagues, and foster collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Challenge and improve. Help develop our FP&A processes, reporting, and tools, including exploring how automation and AI can help us work smarter.

Who you are
First things first: we’re not looking for someone who simply loves spreadsheets and financial reporting. We’re looking for someone who loves understanding a business and using numbers to make a difference.
We believe you bring:
Solid experience in FP&A, business controlling, commercial finance, or a similar business-oriented finance role.
Hands-on experience in tech/B2B SaaS, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue models and key metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, and customer economics.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial data into actionable business insights.
A commercial mindset and experience working closely with stakeholders to influence business decisions.
Experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.
The ability to guide and support others, bring people together, and create structure and momentum in a team.
Professional fluency in English.

Experience leading or coordinating others is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take initiative, bring people together, and lead by example.
Your background doesn’t have to follow the traditional finance path. What matters is that you understand the commercial side, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn insights into action.
High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.
You’ll join a growing international SaaS company where finance plays an important role in shaping the business.
You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. With plenty of room to challenge existing ways of working, bring new ideas, and influence how we grow, this is a role where your contribution will truly matter.
And of course, we want you to enjoy the journey along the way!

30 days of vacation
Wellness allowance
Personal development opportunities
Summits and team activities
Four days from the office and one day from home

AI is only as good as what it knows about the business, so Voyado brings customer, product, order, and behavioral data together in one connected system, creating the context retail runs on. With retail intelligence and agentic reasoning on top, AI agents use that single source of truth to make informed decisions and act across the full customer journey.

We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
Ready to make an impact?
Fantastic! 🎉
Applying is easy — just upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.

5-10 years of experience within product cost controlling of hardware products, or related areas such as Purchasing, R&D, Project Management, or Strategy
Strong analytical capability and a high level of quality awareness and accountability
A structured, communicative, and collaborative working style
The ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling way
A genuine interest in working in a diverse, international environment with stakeholders across the globe
Fluency in English (written and verbal). Swedish or German is considered a strong advantage

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   
With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  
SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   
Want to help create a safer workplace where people can do their best work? 
As Health & Safety Coordinator at Esrange Space Center, you will help managers turn work environment requirements into clear routines and practical improvements. You will work closely with teams across the site to identify risks, strengthen safe working practices and support compliance with Swedish work environment regulations. 
This is a hands-on role combining coordination, analysis and training in a technical environment, where your focus will be occupational health and safety. 

JOB REQUIREMENTS
A relevant university degree in engineering, risk management, occupational health and safety, or equivalent knowledge gained through work experience. 
At least five years of relevant health and safety experience. 
In-depth knowledge of Swedish work environment regulations and experience applying them in practice. 
Experience working at industrial or technical sites in Sweden where operations involve significant health and safety risks. 
Fluency in Swedish and English. 
A category B driving license valid within the European Economic Area. 

You communicate clearly and can explain requirements in a way that helps people understand what they need to do and why. You are comfortable addressing risks, challenging unsafe practices and following up on agreed actions. You bring sound judgement, integrity and an analytical approach, together with the ability to build effective working relationships across different teams. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 
Support managers in systematic work environment management, including risk assessments, safety rounds, allocation of work environment tasks and an annual work environment plan. 
Develop and improve health and safety processes in line with SSC Space’s global management system. 
Provide guidance on Swedish work environment regulations and coordinate health and safety inspections and audits with relevant authorities. 
Support incident investigations and root cause analysis, and follow up on actions to prevent recurrence. 
Establish routines for tracking required training and certificates for high-risk work, such as working at height.  
Coordinate chemical inventories, safety data sheets and chemical risk assessments together with the organization. 
Develop and deliver health and safety training and communication for managers and employees. 
Monitor health and safety indicators, support the Site Manager with performance reporting and contribute to improvements and certification preparations. 

You will collaborate with site management, line managers, safety representatives, HR, the Range Safety Office, the Environmental Manager, the Group HSE Officer and specialists responsible for flammable goods and explosives. 

 JOB BENEFITS 
We offer you   
A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.  
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.  
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   

Additional benefits  
In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.   
Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.  
Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.   
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.  
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.  
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  

LOCATION  
This is a full-time, permanent position based at our space base Esrange outside of Kiruna. 

FURTHER INFORMATION
For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:  
Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com  
Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com  
    
NEXT STEP
If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  
As the application period runs close to the Christmas holidays, please be aware that feedback and next steps may take a little longer than usual. We appreciate your patience during this period.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.  

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE  
SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  
With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.   
 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

Connect brand and product marketing. Make sure product positioning, messaging and launch narratives are aligned with the brand across B2B and B2C, and partner with Trade marketing, PR and Digital to deliver a consistent brand experience across all touchpoints.
Measure and sharpen. Define and follow up on brand KPIs: awareness, consideration, preference and brand equity. Use the insights to sharpen the strategy and present results to senior leadership.

Who you are

Mips has built a strong position in safety, with a technology trusted by leading brands around the world. jobs.occupation: Postdoc in materials informatics and materials digital infrastructure
jobs.description:
Work assignments 
The primary focus of the position is on developing methods and software for making materials data accessible, interoperable, and reusable, as well as for managing, processing, and analyzing large-scale materials datasets. The research aims to advance data-driven materials science by improving the standardization, exchange, and utilization of research data and computational tools.
 
The work may include the development of methods for data management and interoperability, standardized data representations, integration of databases and computational workflows, and the application of AI/machine learning methods to materials data. The research may also involve the development and application of computational physics methods, high-throughput simulations, and data-driven approaches to understanding and predicting materials properties.
 
The position is connected to the EU project MaterialsCommons, which aims to establish a federated European digital infrastructure and a common digital market for materials data and services, connecting databases, computational tools, and other digital resources across institutions and national boundaries.
As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.
Qualifications
To be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree.  This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.
It is considered advantageous if your doctoral degree is no older than three years at application deadline for this job. If there are special reasons for having an older doctoral degree – such as taking statutory leave – then these may be taken into consideration.
Your application must include documents that clearly show that you fulfill the following requirements for the position:
A doctoral degree in physics, materials science, or equivalent. A course transcript with grades must be included in the application.
A record of multiple research publications in theoretical and computational materials science, materials design, and/or materials informatics.
Co-authored publications demonstrating experience with data-driven materials research.
Extensive, documented programming experience, particularly in Python, demonstrated, for example, through co-authored publications describing the use of Python and links to open-source software to which the applicant has contributed.

It is considered a strong merit for the position if your application shows (i) co-authored publications that involve work with materials databases and datasets; (ii) direct technical experience with maintaining materials databases and making research data accessible through them.
It is considered a merit for the position if your application shows: (i) course transcripts demonstrating high grades in completed courses of high relevance to the work assignments; (ii) other documented experience demonstrating a high level of understanding and skill in the fields of thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, group theory, crystallography, and crystal symmetry; (iii) experience with AI/ML for materials science.
You are expected to be creative, independent, and intellectually curious, and to have a high level of engagement and motivation to contribute to materials science and materials data infrastructure.
The workplace
The position is at the Materials Design and Informatics Unit within the Division of Theoretical Physics, Department of Physics, Chemistry and Biology (IFM), Linköping University.
The unit conducts research in theoretical and computational physics, with a particular emphasis on computational materials science and materials informatics. Our research includes large-scale computational studies of materials, development of software and automated workflows for scientific computations, management and analysis of data in large-scale materials databases, and development and application of informatics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) methods in materials science.

Application procedure
Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 8 December, 2026. 
 
 
 
Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. 
 
 
 
Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. 
Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University.
